comments: Free Chrome extension (also installable on Edge; Firefox coming). Uses axe-core for automated checks and adds plain-language explanations in English and Italian. Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hmlaeliabdlcegndhalcafhcmpidljhk
features: Browser extension that checks the open page against WCAG 2.2 A/AA and explains every issue in plain English or Italian: who is affected, how to fix it and where it is, with on-page highlighting. Built for the European Accessibility Act. Runs locally in the browser, no data sent. Based on axe-core.
title: Accessa EAA
